title: ophiorrhiza glandulosa
intro: Ophiorrhiza glandulosa, commonly known as the Himalayan snake grass, is a flowering plant species native to the Himalayan region. It has been traditionally used in medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include reducing fever, alleviating pain, and treating various infectious diseases, thanks to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Ophiorrhiza glandulosa contribute to its overall therapeutic potential, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
